from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u080/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc, grid[rr][cc]))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] != 0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            comps.append(cells)
    sources = [comp for comp in comps if len(comp) > 1 and any(v == 5 for _,_,v in comp)]
    targets = [comp[0] for comp in comps if len(comp) == 1 and comp[0][2] == 5]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if sources and targets:
        src = sources[0]
        ar, ac, _ = next(cell for cell in src if cell[2] == 5)
        tr, tc, _ = targets[0]
        dr, dc = tr-ar, tc-ac
        for r, c, v in src:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
                out[nr][nc] = v
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-07cafb86.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
